_comment: Verifies the TON (on-delay) timer feeding y_done (Y1) in examples/start_stop.json: PT=3000ms. Motor must stay latched (x_start held True, matching the SR wiring quirk documented in start_stop_basic.json) for the timer to keep accumulating elapsed time. To release the latch at the end we drop x_start back to False while x_stop is still False (its default), which drives R=True (via NOT) and resets the SR -- see stop_priority.json for the S/R dominance details.
